entries.title: Man convicted of arson over deadly 2025 Palisades fire in Los Angeles

entries.title: Brazil ex-President Jair Bolsonaro taken to hospital over abdominal pain

entries.title: UK anti-migrant activist jailed for slashing Channel dinghy
entries.snippet: Daniel Thomas, known as "Danny Tommo," slashed a dinghy with a knife while a French rescue worker was on board. The incident was livestreamed to a large social media audience amid growing tensions over migrant crossings.

entries.title: US judge approves Bayer's $7.25 billion cancer settlement
entries.snippet: Bayer could end years of costly lawsuits in the US over claims that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. Tens of thousands of people could now receive compensation, although some lawyers say the payments are too low.

entries.title: Russian ornithologist jailed over small donations to Navalny's foundation
entries.snippet: Sofia Rosenfeld has devoted her life to studying Arctic birds. A Russian court sentenced her to 3.5 years in a penal colony over donations to Navalny's foundation. Friends and family are fighting for her release.

entries.title: Repression against Iranian lawyers increases
entries.snippet: At least 135 lawyers in Iran have been subjected to repressive measures over the past year. UN experts warn that this seriously jeopardizes the right of those accused to trial in a constitutional court.
